registrations.name: agentmemory
registrations.requirements: Own AgentMemory server, assigned project and secret if authentication is required. No capture scope is supplied.

registrations.name: autorag
registrations.requirements: Node/npx, @autorag/librarian@2.13.12, isolated workspace, explicit permission for selected data. Do not enable by default.

registrations.name: board-insights
registrations.requirements: Workbench Kanban data if the page is used. No key.

registrations.name: cache-monitor
registrations.requirements: Pinned Hermes request hooks.

registrations.name: claude-subscription-directsdk-experimental
registrations.requirements: Disabled. A separately installed Claude Code and operator account would be required for use; no probe or auth supplied.

registrations.name: codemode
registrations.requirements: Real typed Hermes SDK. Matching CPython wheels in requirements.lock under .deps/cpXY. Never apply the optional tool-filter patch built for a different host automatically.

registrations.name: covsift
registrations.requirements: Python stdlib; caller-selected local report.

registrations.name: data-toolkit
registrations.requirements: Native manifest Python dependencies; Docling/OCR model assets require separate permission.

registrations.name: heartbeat
registrations.requirements: Local Kanban. Scheduling/delivery is an independent opt-in; no cron job or destination is copied.

registrations.name: hermes-teammates
registrations.requirements: Own roster and model access; no team or credentials included.

registrations.name: kanban-gantt
registrations.requirements: Optional Hermes Desktop/dashboard, Workbench Kanban; no key.

registrations.name: keep-going
registrations.requirements: Hermes todo hooks; gateway follow-up only with operator approval.

registrations.name: llm-wiki
registrations.requirements: Original plugin and plugin skill. In the pack profile, prepare verified Wiki runtime first; installer binds runtime_root and its .venv. No Wiki data copied.

registrations.name: meeting-context
registrations.requirements: Own transcript folder and explicit meeting/topic mappings. Not activated.

registrations.name: memory-bank
registrations.requirements: Original adapter, local team guard and runtime changes. In the pack profile, prepare verified runtimes first; the adapter binds to that prepared runtime.

registrations.name: memory-wiki
registrations.requirements: Own profile only; UI reads history on use. No existing history included.

registrations.name: omh
registrations.requirements: Native bridge; separate pinned OMH CLI/home for optional features, operator key only for optional Jev calls. No user home/roles copied.

registrations.name: openviking
registrations.requirements: Disabled. Set up own OpenViking server, storage, credentials and optional embeddings; no service provisioned.

registrations.name: project-memory-bank
registrations.requirements: Disabled. Own project bindings and directory; plugin includes its licensed runtime subset.

registrations.name: quota
registrations.requirements: Use only operator-selected provider accounts; no auth/keychain/cache transferred.

registrations.name: qyp-delegate
registrations.requirements: Not activated. User-authorized SSH worker, restricted account, allowed workdirs and own credentials.

registrations.name: recall
registrations.requirements: Standalone plugin with recall_search and hooks. No default service URL. Set an explicitly isolated loopback service; capture/index only operator-authorized new data; semantic mode needs licensed models.

registrations.name: reminder-actions
registrations.requirements: Not activated. Own Telegram account, owner, bindings and reminders; no IDs copied.

registrations.name: rtk-rewrite
registrations.requirements: Full native callback; RTK 1.2.0 OSS on Workbench PATH. No shell hooks/global init. See release auxiliary artifact.

registrations.name: soul-composer
registrations.requirements: Original composer, no SOUL, bricks, team, recipes or profiles. On start may build team; use isolated Workbench HOME only.

registrations.name: subagents
registrations.requirements: Hermes delegation hooks and operator model backend. Optional filter requires compatible host; no host patch or model routing copied.

registrations.name: tavily-plugin
registrations.requirements: Hosted Tavily MCP and your own TAVILY_API_KEY (or separately configured supported login); requires compatible Hermes MCP extra.

registrations.name: web-yandex
registrations.requirements: Own Yandex Search API key and folder; optional operator HTTPS context endpoint.

registrations.name: workflows
registrations.requirements: Node, subagents, own model backend; vendored pi-subagents 0.23.0. Review upstream provenance of progress.js before redistributing that file. No service/model run at installation.
